# Code map — 10x-agent-marketplace

<!-- groundwork:codemap facts=2a0865ad8c8d -->

Read this before searching the code: it says where each kind of code lives.

**Layout:** standard (cli profile, root plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review)
New code goes in its role folder; `groundwork.py layout` shows the rules.
**Languages:** Python (collector, tests), Markdown (skills, agents, prompts), JSON (manifests, fixtures)

## Folders

| Folder | Role | Code files | Holds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/core` | core | 12 | Pure rules: domain records (`models.py`), timeframe parsing and year chunks, the `ActivitySource` port, metric rules (`metrics.py`, `cadence.py`, `highlights.py`, `themes.py`, `stats.py`), `report.py` (metrics.json shape), `digest.md` renderer with the 12 KB cap, dashboard and SVG charts, token budget |
| `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/connectors/github` | connectors | 7 | Every GitHub call: host endpoints, token lookup (`gh auth token` fallback), the https transport with retries and SSO detection, GraphQL documents, the `raw/` cache, payload parsing, and `GitHubSource` (collection with year chunking, paging and org filter) |
| `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/entrypoints/cli` | entrypoints | 1 | `collect` command: flags, run folder, writes the seven output files, prints at most 15 lines, exit codes 0/1/2 |
| `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/config` | config | 1 | The only environment reads: token names, `IMPACT_REVIEW_HOST`, `IMPACT_REVIEW_RUNS`, and the standard-library `.env` reader |
| `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/prompts` | prompts | 0 | `rubric.md`, the default five-area self-evaluation rubric copied into each run folder |
| `plugins/impact-review/tests` | tests | 8 | pytest suite with a fake HTTP opener; `fixtures/` holds recorded GitHub responses |
| `plugins/impact-review/skills/report` | plugin | 0 | `SKILL.md` for `/impact-review:report` |
| `plugins/impact-review/agents` | plugin | 0 | `impact-writer.md`, the Sonnet subagent that writes the synthesis files |

## Outside systems (where they are called)

| System | Called from |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs | `connectors/github/http.py` (transport), `connectors/github/source.py` (queries) |
| GitHub CLI (`gh auth token`) | `connectors/github/token.py` |

## Settings (where environment variables are read)

| Name | Read in |
| --- | --- |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN` | `config/settings.py` (names), used by `connectors/github/token.py` |
| `IMPACT_REVIEW_HOST`, `IMPACT_REVIEW_RUNS` | `config/settings.py` |

Secrets: read from environment variables; locally from `.env` (git-ignored); names listed in `.env.example`.

## Entry and wiring files

- `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/__main__.py`: builds the GitHub connector and calls the CLI (`python -m impact_review`).
- `plugins/impact-review/src/impact_review/entrypoints/cli/main.py`: argument parsing and the `collect` command.

## Tests

- `plugins/impact-review/tests/`: `uv run pytest` from the repo root; `pyproject.toml` sets the test path and `pythonpath`.

## Notes

- `.github/workflows/chronicle-evals.yml` runs the chronicle evals in CI; `.github/scripts/eval_summary.py` turns their result document into the job summary table.
- Import rules: `core` imports nothing outside itself; `connectors` and `entrypoints` import `core` and `config`; only `__main__.py` imports both `connectors` and `entrypoints`.
- `groundwork.py` is not vendored in this repo; this map was updated by hand on 2026-10-20 and the facts hash is stale until the next `groundwork.py codemap` run.
- The facts above describe `plugins/impact-review` only. chronicle follows the same cli layout under `plugins/chronicle/src/chronicle/`:

| Folder | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `core/story/` | facts and tokens, derive table, story checks, themes and the sameness review (`theme.py`), the diagram sanitizer, US tile grid (`geo.py`), HTML renderer and block renderers (`blocks.py`, `explainers.py`, `lessons.py`, joined in `dispatch.py`) |
| `core/watercolor/` | painting engine (paper, washes, ink), motifs, presets and the scene language |
| `core/motion/` | animations: the shared checks and step clock (`model.py`), CSS keyframe timeline, stage (title, captions, step strip, the SVG file), the diagram and scene kinds, the packet and visibility parts, render, the HTML figure, frame times and the GIF encoder |
| `core/motion/tad/` | technical architecture diagrams: the spec reader, tier and lane layout, line routing, icons, and the drawing with its motion |
| `core/watercolor/svg/` | SVG drawings: path and transform math (`pathdata.py`), the reader (`parse.py`) and the ink-and-wash painter (`paint.py`) |
| `connectors/files/` | every file read and write: JSON, HTML, WebP, bundled assets |
| `connectors/browser/` | an installed headless Chromium or Chrome: page screenshots (`shoot.py`) and animation frames over the DevTools pipe (`devtools.py`) |
| `connectors/video/` | MP4 through the installed ffmpeg program, WebM through OpenCV's video writer |
| `entrypoints/cli/` | the `chronicle` command: new, check, paint, build, shoot, motifs (`main.py`), `animate new/check/build` (`animate.py`), painting shared by both (`art.py`), run folders (`runs.py`) |
| `assets/` | `fonts.json`, the font families a theme may use, with their weight axes |
| `assets/css/` | the page stylesheet in numbered parts: base, page, identity (marks, progress devices, stat skins), explainers, and the drawn-figure classes that animations share (`40-drawn.css`) |
| `assets/motion/` | the animation stylesheet in numbered parts: stage, TAD, diagram, scene |
| `assets/js/` | the page runtime in numbered parts, joined inside one IIFE: core, charts, figures, plates, progress, explainers, lessons, boot |
| `plugins/chronicle/examples/` | worked examples with invented data: `keystone/` (status page), `onboarding/` (handbook with a widget), `quarterly/`, and the animations `animation-tad/`, `animation-diagram/`, `animation-scene/` |
| `plugins/chronicle/tests/` | pytest suite, run from the repo root with `uv run pytest` |
| `plugins/chronicle/evals/` | `claude plugin eval` cases: one folder per case with `prompt.md`, `graders/` and, for the safety case, `case.yaml` and `setup.sh` |

speedup follows the same cli layout under `plugins/speedup/src/speedup/`:

| Folder | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `core/` | domain records (`model.py`), project file checks (`project.py`), daily bucketing, imports and change records (`records.py`), statistics (`stats.py`), journey, change and benchmark analysis (`analysis.py`), the ratchet (`ratchet.py`), `metrics.json` (`report.py`), digest with the 12 KB cap, token budget, number formats, SVG charts, dashboard, Markdown renderer, write-up tokens (`writeup.py`), the `SeriesSource` port |
| `connectors/http.py` | the one JSON transport: https only, retries, read-only POST allowlist, no secrets in logs |
| `connectors/datadog/` | Datadog sites and the metric and RUM queries |
| `connectors/prometheus/` | Prometheus range queries |
| `connectors/bench/` | runs benchmark commands as argument lists and parses their numbers |
| `connectors/files/` | project file, change log and the data folder |
| `entrypoints/cli/` | the `speedup` command: init, measure, import, bench, guard, tighten, log, report, writeup |
| `config/` | the only environment reads: Datadog keys and site, Prometheus, runs folder, project file path |
| `prompts/` | `writeup-outline.md`, the write-up's sections and voice |
| `plugins/speedup/examples/` | `demo/` (invented Lumen project, imports and a sample write-up), `github-actions/` (guard and tighten workflow) |
| `plugins/speedup/tests/` | pytest suite with recorded Datadog and Prometheus responses in `fixtures/` |
